name: Ouji-sama Lv2
source:
The next morning after events of the prequel Canaan and Celeste are summoned to the first prince. A travelling botanist is attacked by roots of the trees opening path to underground ruins, and heroes are asked to investigate it.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
